title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
text: Performs multi-group differential expression analysis using intensity-dependent local pooled error variance trend.

title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
code: LPE_ANOVA(   object,   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   trim.method = c("mad", "quantile", "fixed"),   d = 1.2,   use_weighted_between = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE,   p.method = c("chisq", "F_inf") )

title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
text: object list returned LPE_preprocess(). n.bin Number quantile bins used variance trend estimation. df Degrees freedom smoothing spline. trim.method Outlier trimming method. One "mad", "quantile", "fixed". d Fixed trimming threshold used trim.method = "fixed". use_weighted_between Logical. Whether include weighted -group differences variance trend estimation. verbose Logical. Whether print progress messages. p.method P-value calculation method. One "chisq" "F_inf".

what: Estimate Intensity-Dependent Variance Trend for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA_var
title: Estimate Intensity-Dependent Variance Trend for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA_var
text: function estimates intensity-dependent variance trend using within-group pairwise differences. Optionally, weighted -group differences can included replicate information limited.

title: Estimate Intensity-Dependent Variance Trend for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA_var
code: LPE_ANOVA_var(   expr,   group,   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   trim.method = c("mad", "quantile", "fixed"),   d = 1.2,   use_weighted_between = FALSE )

title: Estimate Intensity-Dependent Variance Trend for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA_var
text: expr numeric expression matrix genes rows samples columns. group factor vector indicating sample group labels. n.bin Number quantile bins used variance trend estimation. df Degrees freedom smoothing spline. trim.method Outlier trimming method. One "mad", "quantile", "fixed". d Fixed trimming threshold used trim.method = "fixed". use_weighted_between Logical. Whether include weighted -group differences.

title: Estimate Intensity-Dependent Variance Trend for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA_var
text: smooth.spline object representing estimated variance trend.

what: Preprocess RNA-seq Count Data for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_preprocess
title: Preprocess RNA-seq Count Data for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_preprocess
text: function checks raw count data, filters low-count genes, normalizes sample-level library size differences, optionally applies log2 transformation.

title: Preprocess RNA-seq Count Data for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_preprocess
code: LPE_preprocess(   counts,   colData,   design = ~group,   normalize.method = c("library_size", "TMM", "DESeq2", "none"),   log.transform = TRUE,   min.count = 5,   prior.count = 1,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Preprocess RNA-seq Count Data for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_preprocess
text: counts numeric matrix raw counts genes rows samples columns. colData data.frame containing sample-level metadata. Row names must match column names counts. design one-way design formula, ~ group. normalize.method Normalization method. One "TMM", "library_size", "DESeq2", "none". log.transform Logical. Whether apply log2 transformation. min.count Minimum count threshold low-count filtering. prior.count Prior count added log transformation. verbose Logical. Whether print progress messages.

title: Preprocess RNA-seq Count Data for LPE-ANOVA — LPE_preprocess
text: list containing normalized expression matrix, group factor, design, colData, preprocessing options.
